title: Processing Multivariate Time-Series Electronic Health Records of COVID-19 Patients
author: Wang, Zhu, et al.

steps.title: Download raw EHR dataset
steps.instruction: Download the file time_series_375_prerpocess_en.xlsx from the GitHub repository (https://github.com/HAIRLAB/Pre_Surv_COVID_19/tree/master/data) or directly with the command: wget -L https://raw.github.com/HAIRLAB/Pre_Surv_COVID_19/master/data/time_series_375_prerpocess_en.xlsx.  Ensure compliance with the dataset’s license.

steps.title: Place data and run script
steps.instruction: Copy the downloaded Excel file into the folder datasets/tjh/raw inside the repository directory Fieldry-DataProcessCovid19-078cef8, then execute the provided Python script standardize_preprocess.py from that directory to perform the subsequent processing steps.

steps.title: Standardize raw data to table
steps.instruction: Transform the raw ICU records into a multivariate time‑series EHR table where column 1 = PatientID, column 2 = RecordTime, column 3 = AdmissionTime, column 4 = DischargeTime, column 5 = Outcome (0 = survival, 1 = death), and columns 6 to last contain demographic information and laboratory test results for each time point, as illustrated in Table 2.

steps.title: Format time‑series table
steps.instruction: Apply a series of formatting operations to the standardized table to obtain the final formatted multivariate time‑series EHR table (Table 3).

substeps.instruction: Convert Gender values to binary (1 = male, 0 = female) and keep year/month/day format for RecordTime, AdmissionTime, and DischargeTime.

Clean missing data: keep only rows where PatientID, RecordTime, AdmissionTime, and DischargeTime are present; delete any rows missing these fields; drop columns that are entirely missing or have a constant value.
Merge records by date: group rows by PatientID and RecordTime (daily resolution) and compute the mean of all numeric features within each group, producing one record per patient per day.
Calculate Length of Stay (LOS): LOS (days) = DischargeTime – RecordTime; set any negative LOS values to 0.
